what_it_is: Indrajaal is Grene Robotics' autonomous wide-area counter-drone defence system - an AI-native 'defence dome' that fuses a site's existing radars, RF sensors and effectors into one autonomous command layer, marketed for 1,000-2,000 sq km coverage per system against nano-to-large drones and loitering munitions.
india_angle: Grene unveiled Indrajaal in 2021 as India's first autonomous wide-area C-UAS and markets it for ports, refineries and defence estates. It is the flagship private Indian entry in wide-area autonomous air defence.
intelligence_assessment: See the Grene Robotics company dossier (Tier A) for the verified evidence base; this system page tracks the platform itself. Deployment scale and named Indian customers remain unconfirmed publicly - the primary open question.

faq.q: Is Indrajaal operational at Indian bases?
faq.a: No government deployment has been publicly confirmed; public evidence is company announcements and press.
